thread:
sre_alan: FYI seeing a spike in GPU node onboarding failures across us-west-2 after the midnight KMS rotation + new egress qos. warmup_success ~47%.

infra_mei: logs: repeated 'dial tcp 10.13.14.5:443: i/o timeout' then 'keystore: decrypt AccessDenied' in bootstrap sequence. connecting flows hit privatelink NATs that are dropping state.

ops_jules: started correlating, rotation generated short-lived fanout as each shipper fetched new keys; egress qos reduced conntrack buckets to limit blast radius -> half-open TLS handshakes lost.

sre_alan: immediate impact: Dedicated customers seeing cold-starts >2.5m, autoscaler is spinning new nodes slower due to warmup failures.

sec_rafa: we intentionally tightened egress to reduce lateral risk. I'll approve a short-lived exception but must be via TF and with TTL/audit. propose 25m.

infra_mei: TF snippet I'll push (annotated): ```hcl
resource "fw_rule" "tmp_warmup_allow_1749998889" {
  name = "tmp-warmup-allow-1749998889"
  src_tag = "svc:gpu-warmup"
  dst_cidrs = ["10.13.14.0/24"]
  ttl_minutes = 25
  meta = { incident = "1749998889" }
}
```
apply in 2m to canary.

deploybot: queued canary apply to us-west-2-canary (15 nodes).

ops_jules: workaround: enable local artifact cache and increase warmup concurrency: `kubectl patch ds gpu-warmup -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"infra/warmup-concurrency":"4","infra/warmup-cache":"enabled"}}}}}'` Canary jumped to 90% success.

sre_alan: Medium-term fixes: 1) stagger KMS rotations by region/az so they don't coincide globally, 2) add pre-rotation conntrack headroom check, 3) autoscale privatelink NAT pools and conntrack.

sec_rafa: agree on staggering. will update rotation playbook to require a headroom check and an approval gate if conntrack_util > 0.6.

finance_zoe: cost estimate for autoscaling NATs + bigger conntrack pools ~+$3.6k/mo if we keep higher baseline. tag to infra budget.

infra_mei: monitoring tasks: add alerts: `gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.85 for 5m`, `privatelink_conntrack_util > 0.9`, `keystore_decrypt_access_denied > 3/min`. also add metric `warmup_keystore_handshake_failures`.

ops_jules: logging change: add label `mitigation=tmp-warmup-1749998889` to warmup logs and shipper logs for correlation.

sec_rafa: temporary exception approved for 25m, TF change applied to canary and rolling. ensure audit ticket references rotation ID.

sre_alan: canary green, rolling to region now. I'll open a postmortem with owner and action items for rotation staggering and runbook updates. thanks team. :thumbsup:
